question: In the game of Ice hockey, during normal play how many players are there in each team on the ice at any one time to compete?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **regular ice hockey, **there are** six players on the ice for each team,** including a goaltender.
 
• Typically, this consists of** two defenders, two wings, and one center**.
 
• Penalties can lead to a decrease in the number of players on the ice.
 
• In **international hockey, **teams have **eleven players,** with ten field players and one goalkeeper.
 
• During international matches, teams can have up to 16 players in their squad, but they must name a minimum of 14 players for the match.
